title: Maximize Happiness of Selected Children
summary: Given an array of happiness values and a positive integer k, select k children to maximize the sum of their happiness values.
statement: Given an array of happiness values and a positive integer k, select k children to maximize the sum of their happiness values. In each turn, the happiness of unselected children decreases by 1, but not below zero.
constraints: happiness contains positive integers and 1≤k≤its length.
On turn t starting at zero, the selected child contributes max(original happiness-t,0).
Choose exactly k distinct children and maximize the total contribution.
hints: At any turn, selecting a larger original value never gives less contribution than selecting a smaller one.
Sort descending and take the first k values, subtracting the zero-based turn and flooring at zero.
Sum max(sorted_descending[t]-t,0) for t from zero through k-1.
An exchange that moves a larger unselected value earlier cannot decrease either affected contribution, so descending order is optimal.
editorial: An exchange that moves a larger unselected value earlier cannot decrease either affected contribution, so descending order is optimal.
